product_one_liner.value: Jack & Jill pairs an AI career agent that helps candidates find jobs with an AI recruiting agent that helps companies source and hire candidates through direct introductions.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes Jack as an AI agent for a candidate’s career and Jill as an AI agent for hiring, which introduce a candidate and company directly when they match. This supports the one-sentence product description.

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page lists free candidate and “Meet Jill” offerings and a paid “Hire Jill” plan priced from $199 per active role per month.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The company’s customer-story index directly names Attio and Anima as featured stories about hiring with Jill. | named_customers.0: The customer-story index names Attio as a featured Jill customer story. | named_customers.1: The customer-story index names Anima as a featured Jill customer story.

employee_band.notes: The company’s team page says it has 28 people; 28 falls in the 21-50 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company’s registered address is in London, England, and its team page describes the operation as based in London and San Francisco. London is the best-supported city for its headquarters, though the company also has a San Francisco presence. | hq_country: The legal terms give the registered address as London, England, and the team page places the company’s 28-person operation in London and San Francisco. This supports the UK as its principal country, while the page does not label a single formal headquarters, so confidence is medium.

founded_year.notes: Jack & Jill’s own llms.txt quick facts directly state “Founded: 2024.” A LinkedIn-derived snippet elsewhere says 2025, so I prefer the company’s directly maintained canonical facts; the discrepancy lowers confidence.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index shows company announcements, product and hiring advice, an AI-sourcing commentary by the CEO, and panel notes; it does not show two posts about product construction by engineers. Under the requested definition this is not an engineering blog.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation index links to multiple guides covering Jill, setup, candidate discovery, hiring briefs, introductions, pipeline management, team permissions, and integrations, meeting the requirement for several public product-documentation articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page lists open roles including Founding Engineer, but none of the listed job titles contains AI, ML, data science, or another qualifying term. Per the title-based rule, the answer is false.

model_provider.notes: The terms mention AI and large language models only generically; the privacy policy refers generically to third-party AI and hosting providers; and the public docs index lists product guides and integrations without naming a model vendor. I found no public statement in these first-party sources identifying the model provider, so it remains unknown.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The company privacy policy explicitly names UK GDPR in describing users’ rights. GDPR is the only item from the requested list named there; it does not name SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, or PCI DSS in the cited passage. The policy refers to GDPR rights rather than describing a formal certification, so confidence is medium. | compliance_certs.0: The cited privacy-policy passage names UK GDPR; this is the sole listed compliance item present in the cited passage.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The company’s own canonical facts explicitly identify the most recent round as a Series A dated 15 September 2026. | funding_date: The company’s own canonical facts date its $40M Series A to 15 September 2026, which converts to YYYY-MM as 2026-09. | funding_amount_usd: The company’s own canonical facts say it raised a $40M Series A on 15 September 2026; $40M equals USD 40,000,000.

raised_18mo.notes: The company announced a $40M Series A on 15 September 2026, within the 18 months before 9 November 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live careers page lists Account Executive openings in both San Francisco and London, so the company is hiring for a qualifying role.

launched_6mo.notes: The company’s blog dated 4 November 2026 states “Today we’re launching Company Insights in Jill.” This is within the six months before 9 November 2026 and is an explicit product-feature launch.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The complete small team roster identifies Matthew Wilson and Saaras Mehan as co-founder CEO and co-founder CTO, respectively, and identifies no other C-level or VP-level member; the company states it was founded in 2024. I found no dated announcement of an executive departure or new C/VP appointment in the period. The roster has no individual start dates, so the negative is an inference and confidence is medium.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The docs/integrations page and Jack & Jill’s own GTM Engineer posting were readable. The integrations listed are ATS products and Slack, and the posting refers to GTM systems without naming a CRM or sales/marketing system. Therefore the list is empty.
